images.alt: Image of a baby’s hand gently holding an adult finger, photographed in soft, warm lighting with a blurred background. White text at the top reads ‘Safe Sleep Day’ and ‘5 June 2026’. At the bottom are the New Zealand Government Te Kāwanatanga o Aotearoa and Ministry of Health Manatū Hauora logos.

post.text: Today (5 June) is Safe Sleep Day which focuses on raising awareness and ensuring every sleep a baby has is a safe sleep.  It is a good reminder to make sure we put our babies to sleep safely.

source.notes: Public AT Protocol profile and posts can be captured without live-posting side effects.
